episodes.title: Haz una pausa
episodes.script:
Si hoy sientes que no puedes con todo,
haz una pausa.
episodes.scene_description: Sofi is seated in the beige armchair, looking directly at camera. Breathes softly before speaking. Empathetic and calm expression.
episodes.movement: Warm gaze, slow breathing, slight head tilt
episodes.voice_notes: Warm, calm, intimate female voice. Neutral Latin American Spanish. Slow rhythm with natural pauses. Empathetic and soothing tone.
